text: ANNOUNCEMENT: The AI and Machine Learning Club will host a beginner workshop on Python this Friday at 3 PM in Lab 204. Students should bring their laptops and register through the campus portal.
NOTICE: The university library will remain open until 10 PM during examination week. Students must carry their ID cards and maintain silence in all reading areas.
EVENT UPDATE: The annual technology festival InnovateX will take place on 18 November in the main auditorium. Teams can register for robotics, coding, and data science competitions.
IMPORTANT: The internal assessment for Database Management Systems is scheduled for Monday at 9 AM. Please check the student portal for room allocation.
CLUB NEWS: The Entrepreneurship Cell is organizing a startup idea pitch session next Wednesday. Each team will have five minutes to present its idea and answer questions.
SPORTS NOTICE: Basketball team trials will be held at the sports complex on Saturday at 7 AM. Participants should wear sports shoes and bring student identification.
WORKSHOP: A resume-building session for second-year students will be conducted by the Career Development Centre on Thursday at 2 PM in Seminar Hall B.
CAMPUS ALERT: Due to scheduled maintenance, Wi-Fi access in Block C may be interrupted between 6 PM and 7 PM today. Please save your work in advance.
PLACEMENT UPDATE: The campus placement orientation will explain interview etiquette, aptitude preparation, and company registration. Attendance is recommended for eligible students.
ANNOUNCEMENT: The sustainability committee is conducting a campus clean-up drive on Sunday morning. Volunteers can collect gloves and bags from the student activity office.
EXAM REMINDER: Students must arrive at the examination hall fifteen minutes before the test begins. Electronic devices are not permitted unless specifically authorized.
CULTURAL EVENT: The college music society will perform at the open-air stage on Friday evening. Entry is free for students with a valid campus ID.
ACADEMIC NOTICE: The Python programming lab submission deadline has been extended to 5 PM on Tuesday. Upload the notebook and output screenshots to the learning portal.
STUDENT SERVICES: Applications for hostel room changes must be submitted to the warden before the end of the month. Requests will be reviewed based on availability.
TECH TALK: An invited data analyst will discuss dashboards, business intelligence, and career opportunities on 21 November at 11 AM in the seminar hall.
PRODUCT: EcoSip Bottle. DESCRIPTION: A reusable stainless-steel water bottle designed for everyday campus use. It has a leak-resistant lid, a lightweight body, and a capacity of 750 millilitres.
PRODUCT: StudyLite Desk Lamp. DESCRIPTION: An adjustable LED lamp with three brightness levels and a compact base. It is suitable for reading, studying, and late-night assignments.
PRODUCT: NotePro Notebook. DESCRIPTION: A durable ruled notebook with 200 pages and a flexible cover. It is designed for lecture notes, planning, and daily writing.
PRODUCT: Campus Backpack. DESCRIPTION: A water-resistant backpack with a padded laptop compartment, multiple organizer pockets, and adjustable shoulder straps.
PRODUCT: QuietSound Headphones. DESCRIPTION: Over-ear headphones with cushioned ear pads, a built-in microphone, and a foldable design for studying and travelling.

SHORT STORY: The power went out just before the presentation. Instead of giving up, the students gathered near the windows and explained their solar-energy project using a hand-drawn diagram.

ANNOUNCEMENT: The data visualization assignment must include a dashboard, at least three meaningful insights, and a short explanation of the data source. Submit the report as a PDF.
NOTICE: Students attending the industry visit should assemble outside the main gate at 8 AM. Closed shoes are required, and the consent form must be submitted beforehand.
EVENT UPDATE: The student innovation showcase invites teams to demonstrate prototypes related to health, education, sustainability, and accessible technology.
ACADEMIC SUPPORT: Peer tutoring for introductory statistics is available in the learning centre every Tuesday and Thursday from 4 PM to 5 PM.
ANNOUNCEMENT: The photography club is hosting a photo walk around campus this weekend. Participants should bring a camera or smartphone and follow the event coordinator's instructions.
